_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from cited public records and reporting. Legal status and organizational roles are time-bound to the cited source dates; unproven allegations are labeled charged or reported. Public senior figures only; country-level regions only; no operational route or enforcement-weakness information. No photos included because a reliable reuse license and credit were not verified.
